A Saturday breach. Help desk, a stolen login, the board's eyes.
Then the corner. And the question under every badge.
You took the big chair. Keep the sentence honest.
You left the building. The craft came with you.
You stayed with the hardest problems in the building.
This bank is yours to guard. The climb goes on.
The chair went to Theo. You are still on the ladder.
The lobby doors close behind you. The truth stayed inside.
You stepped off while you could still feel your hands.

endings.name: a Shown the Door
lines: Elena
You hid a breach. The board knows. This ends today.
Nadia
I can't protect a secret you kept from the company.
Richard
Trust was the job. You spent it. We're finished.
Marcus
I would have stood next to the truth. This, I can't.
The Fortune 500 stops calling. Word travels in this work.
Jordan
Come home. We'll eat. Fall apart after the noodles.

endings.name: b Burned Out
lines: Marcus
Bigger title, same shake in your hands. I'm calling it.
Jordan
Recruiter can leave a message. You're leaving the building.
Sam
I'll cover the pager. Don't you dare thank me tonight.
Elena
The seat will wait, or it won't. You won't, if you stay.
You step off the ladder while it is still standing.

Elena

Elena

Jordan
If the new town has noodles, I expect a couch.
Theo
Enjoy the view. Views change. People barely do.
Elena

Elena

endings.name: d Virtual CISO
lines: No one lobby. Many doors. The work stays yours.
Jordan
Clients now. Do they get a key, or just me talking?
Marcus
Charge them the truth. It's the thing you won't fake.
Sam
Call me when one of them is on fire. I'll bring cans.
Dana
Freedom is still a job. Act like it on Mondays.

endings.name: e Principal Engineer
lines: Theo can have the carpet. You keep the problems worth solving.
Sam
Principal. Fancy. You still answer when I page.
Marcus
The ladder's a suggestion. You just proved it.
Marcus

endings.name: f The Chair
lines: Elena
The chair is yours. This bank, not the giant. Earn the rest.
Theo
Well played. I'll land somewhere with softer lights.
Richard
Don't make me regret the quieter candidate.
Marcus
Director was the rehearsal. Don't become your calendar.

endings.name: g Passed Over
lines: Theo takes the chair. You stay. The climb is not over.
Theo
No hard feelings. I'll need your team. Try to look glad.
Marcus
Chairs are furniture. You still know where the risk hides.
Sam
Good. I didn't want to break in a new boss anyway.
Elena
Stay sharp. Another door is still on this floor.
